introduction: Follow the Rice Fields’ map purchase, sprite canning, captive princess and helmsman exchanges, then explore rice work, the Oberon battle, royal reunion, three-zone treasure and safe sea travel.
orientation: Explore the rice fields, worker camp, battle decks and sea routes. Keep a safe way back and prepare for each route’s real travel and combat costs.
The halfling’s fifty-platinum map purchase is a service. Buying a map and successfully using it are distinct; the paid exchange remains guarded while its accounting support is unavailable.
The canner accepts one exact wood sprite for a sprite in a jar. The current exchange has no coin fee, despite the canning-price description.
Marn’s brig key opens the princess’s cell. Miu Pai’s set of keys instead fits the princess’s shackle exchange; the two keys have different jobs.
Prepare a wood sprite, set of keys or packet of sea maps loose in your inventory for its matching exchange. Equipped or packed-away materials do not satisfy that current preparation.
Recovered or supplied exact materials fit their native requests. A supplied item does not claim your own first recovery, personal kill or earlier visit to its source.
The princess’s accepted keys-for-token exchange stays recorded after the keys are spent. Her departure does not yet prove a living arrival at the Palace or complete the Emperor’s separate request.
The helmsman takes a packet of sea maps without a response or reward. This records use of a service; sailing, navigation and rescue need further integration.

A selected pirate carries a torn map. Burgadan can exchange it for a spade and another map, while Hordine separately trades a torn map for a treasure key. Preserve each material for the next chosen exchange.

The spade fits the silt entrance, while the treasure key fits the sunken chest. Opening a route, spending a key and actually receiving treasure are separate events; underwater digging is not this route.
The fixed planks respond to JUMP and lead into sea routes. Prepare for water, breath, capacity, arrows and one-way travel; a handled command does not guarantee a safe landing.

Rice work, sprite care, crew protection, royal reunion, useful navigation and safe sea rescue suggest longer stories. Their useful living outcomes need further integration before they can be completed.

contacts.name: a jellyfish
contacts.description: These jellyfish can appear in the Rice Fields’ underwater rooms although their home prototypes belong to Thetis. Meeting one here does not discover Thetis or complete a sea rescue.

contacts.name: a sea turtle
contacts.description: These turtles can appear near the local sea route although their home prototypes belong to Thetis. Current sightings, safe travel and useful care are distinct from merely meeting wildlife.

contacts.name: a water ox
contacts.description: Water oxen are quite familiar with working in the rice fields.

contacts.name: a huge olyx
contacts.description: This huge cow-like beast is renowned for its strength and timidness.

contacts.name: a halfling adventurer
contacts.description: The halfling sells a map of Jade for fifty platinum. Buying information is a service. A recovered or supplied map can also be offered to the lost legionaire in Jade without buying one here first.

contacts.name: a canner
contacts.description: The canner accepts a wood sprite and returns a sprite in a jar. This exact craft currently charges no coin fee. The jar is a totem; making it does not yet prove that the sprite was helped or that a spell succeeded.

contacts.name: a packer
contacts.description: This poor fellow spends every day in the muck of the rice fields, ploughing and packing up rice.

contacts.name: a mosquito swarm
contacts.description: Mosquitoes love swamps, they spawn in the wet, damp, muck around the rice fields and populate to incredible numbers.

contacts.name: an oberon crewman
contacts.description: One of the sailors of the Oberon, this crewman barely has time to glance up at you as he rushes by, swinging his saber against the oncoming pirates.

contacts.name: an oberon crewman
contacts.description: He swings his blade viciously, forcing the advancing pirates back from along the grappling line, while shouting to his companions.

contacts.name: the captain of the oberon
contacts.description: With one eye constantly watching the water outside and his helmsman, the other eye focused with steel-like resolve on the enemy ship just fifteen feet away, the captain leads his men to battle against the pirates with grim determination.

contacts.name: a pirate
contacts.description: This ruthless pirate is in the heat of battle with the Oberon crew, but at this point he barely cares who he attacks.

contacts.name: Miu Pai
contacts.description: Miu Pai carries the set of keys accepted by the captive princess. These shackle keys are different from Marn’s brig key. Supplying an exact set is eligible without defeating Miu Pai yourself.

contacts.name: the first mate
contacts.description: The first mate of the Oberon looks up at you hastily when he sees you arrive.

contacts.name: a reef shark
contacts.description: This shark has been attracted to the Jade inlet by the fierce fighting going on on the ships above.

contacts.name: a captive princess of jade
contacts.description: The princess accepts a set of keys, gives a royal token and departs. That accepted release is recorded. Her actual safe arrival at the Palace and the Emperor’s separate token exchange are further outcomes.

contacts.name: a pirate archer
contacts.description: The archer attacks travelers in selected neighboring battle rooms. Learn the real route and prepare for danger; surviving arrows or ordinary combat does not yet record a saved ship or protected crew.

contacts.name: the oberon helmsman
contacts.description: The helmsman accepts a packet of sea maps. This service currently has no response or reward and does not make the ship sail. Hordine has a separate competing use for the same maps.

contacts.name: a pirate
contacts.description: Only one selected pirate source carries the torn map. It points toward independent dealings with Burgadan and Hordine, then silt and a sunken chest. A supplied torn map remains useful.

stories.title: Buy a map of Jade
stories.summary: The halfling sells a map for fifty platinum. This paid information service remains guarded while its accounting support is unavailable. Receiving a map does not establish personal travel or complete the legionaire’s separate request.
